camel_example: aliyun live AddLiveSnapshotDetectPornConfig --region cn-hangzhou --OssEndpoint 'cn-oss-0000.aliyuncs.com' --DomainName 'example.com' --OssBucket livebucket --AppName testApp
description_en: Adds a video moderation configuration for live streams in an application under a domain name
description_zh: 可按照域名和App级别配置播流审核服务
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-snapshot-detect-porn-config --domain-name example.com --app-name testApp --oss-endpoint cn-oss-0000.aliyuncs.com --oss-bucket livebucket --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLiveSnapshotDetectPornConfig

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs
parameters.help_zh:
播流所属应用名称。
 
AppName名称与推流地址中的AppName名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

After the review is complete, you can search for specific violations in the OSS console based on the callback information. You must configure the OSS endpoint in advance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199449.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储Endpoint名称。

审核完成后，您可以根据审核回调信息，在OSS控制台查找指定的审核内容。OSS Endpoint需要提前创建，创建方法请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199449.html
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OSS bucket.

After the review is complete, you can search for specific violations in the OSS console based on the callback information. You must create the OSS bucket in advance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199449.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储Bucket名称。

审核完成后，您可以根据审核回调信息，在OSS控制台查找指定的审核内容。OSS Bucket需要提前创建，创建方法请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199449.html
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The name of the snapshot that stores violations such as pornographic content and politically sensitive content
parameters.help_zh: 保存涉黄涉政等违规图片名称
parameters.name: oss_object

parameters.help_en: The interval at which snapshots are captured from the live stream. Valid values: 5 to 3600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 采样间隔。取值范围：5~3600。单位：秒
parameters.name: interval
